The four boosters are to be added to the starter deck, as mail to the
princes running the events (via the prince list) indicated.

> It's interesting to note that you, too, have had trouble getting
> answers from ww lately. Is there some problem guys? Are you out there?

Posting to the NG asking for email is probably not the most effective route -
you'll likely get better results via the prince list (if you're a prince)
or direct email.
